tools.name: engagedly_list_users
tools.description: List employees with name, email, status, title, employee id and manager data. Filter by email. Use include to embed primary_reporter or direct_reports. API: GET /beta/users.

tools.name: engagedly_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with profile fields and optional related data. API: GET /beta/users/{id}.

tools.name: engagedly_get_user_permissions
tools.description: Get the permissions of one user. API: GET /beta/users/{id}/permissions.

tools.name: engagedly_list_user_attributes
tools.description: List the system and custom user attributes of the organization (keys, data types, options, mandatory flag). API: GET /beta/user-attributes.

tools.name: engagedly_list_block_reason_codes
tools.description: List the reason codes that Engagedly uses when it blocks a user. API: GET /beta/users/block-reason-codes.

tools.name: engagedly_list_departments
tools.description: List departments of the organization. API: GET /beta/departments.

tools.name: engagedly_get_department
tools.description: Get one department by id. API: GET /beta/departments/{id}.

tools.name: engagedly_list_businesses
tools.description: List business units of the organization. API: GET /beta/businesses.

tools.name: engagedly_get_business
tools.description: Get one business by id. API: GET /beta/businesses/{id}.

tools.name: engagedly_list_locations
tools.description: List locations of the organization. API: GET /beta/locations.

tools.name: engagedly_get_location
tools.description: Get one location by id. API: GET /beta/locations/{id}.

tools.name: engagedly_list_job_titles
tools.description: List job titles of the organization. API: GET /beta/job_titles.

tools.name: engagedly_get_job_title
tools.description: Get one job title by id. API: GET /beta/job_titles/{id}.

tools.name: engagedly_list_permissions
tools.description: List the permissions that exist in the organization. API: GET /beta/permissions.

tools.name: engagedly_list_praises
tools.description: List public praises (recognition posts) between employees. API: GET /beta/activities/praises.

tools.name: engagedly_list_learning_resources
tools.description: List courses and playlists with filters (title text, type, language, provider, level, tags, duration, certified, archived, short code). Each item has an id and a short_code. API: GET /beta/learning/resources.

tools.name: engagedly_get_learning_resource_contents
tools.description: Get the content hierarchy (sections and items) of one course or playlist. API: GET /beta/learning/resources/{id}/contents.

tools.name: engagedly_get_learner_report
tools.description: Report of learner progress per course or playlist. Filter by resource ids or types. API: GET /beta/learning/learner_reports.

tools.name: engagedly_list_certificates
tools.description: List certificates awarded to employees (name, authority, validity dates). Filter by user, term, dates or status. API: GET /beta/certificates.

tools.name: engagedly_get_certificate
tools.description: Get one certificate by id. API: GET /beta/certificates/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: engagedly_list_users, engagedly_list_praises · Public sink: engagedly_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: engagedly_list_users, engagedly_list_praises · Public sink: engagedly_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
